object:candelabrum / Candelabrum of Invo.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a gold seven-branched candelabrum with a wide foot and unlit cup-like tips. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:candelabrum / Candelabrum of Invo.wikiDescription: The Candelabrum of Invocation is a unique ritual item used in the Invocation. The source label names the artifact; the tile gives its gold multi-arm appearance.
object:candelabrum / Candelabrum of Invo.modelBrief: Build a stable gold pedestal rising into seven candle cups, keeping each branch separated and unlit. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:silver bell / Bell of Opening.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a tall silver bell with a loop handle, narrow neck, and broad dark-rimmed mouth. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:silver bell / Bell of Opening.wikiDescription: The Bell of Opening is a unique Invocation item. Its silver-bell appearance is visible here; the ritual role does not add visible glow.
object:silver bell / Bell of Opening.modelBrief: Build a small polished silver handbell with an oval loop, flared mouth, and dark opening. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:tripe ration.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a heap of glossy dark reddish-brown folded meat with orange highlights. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:tripe ration.wikiDescription: A tripe ration is a fleshy edible item in NetHack. The wiki does not prescribe this heap shape or color.
object:tripe ration.modelBrief: Build an irregular folded heap of dark red tripe with broad wet-looking lobes and restrained highlights. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:corpse.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a dark brown lump of meat with a red cut face, a pale protruding bone, and a small tail-like end. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:corpse.wikiDescription: A corpse is the body of a dead monster and can vary by species. This generic tile should not imply a fixed creature anatomy.
object:corpse.modelBrief: Build a compact generic carcass chunk with one pale bone protrusion and red exposed section, without species-specific limbs. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:egg.visualDescription: PixelHack shows one upright ivory egg with tan lower shading and a bright white highlight. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:egg.wikiDescription: An egg is an edible item that may hatch into a monster if left uneaten. The pictured shell gives no species clue.
object:egg.modelBrief: Build a single oval cream shell with a broad pale glint and tan shadow near its base. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:meatball.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a small red-brown round meatball with yellow-orange speckles. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:meatball.wikiDescription: A meatball is a fleshy comestible in NetHack. Its size and cooked-looking color are PixelHack choices.
object:meatball.modelBrief: Build one compact round red-brown meatball with a few warm uneven surface highlights. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:meat stick.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a thin red-brown meat stick bent slightly upward at one end. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:meat stick.wikiDescription: A meat stick is a fleshy comestible in NetHack, distinct from the spherical meatball.
object:meat stick.modelBrief: Build a narrow irregular sausage-like stick of meat with dark ends and a low curved silhouette. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:enormous meatball.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a very large red mound with orange flecks, broad flat base, and uneven top. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:enormous meatball.wikiDescription: The enormous meatball is an oversized fleshy food item. The tile emphasizes size relative to the ordinary meatball.
object:enormous meatball.modelBrief: Build an oversized irregular rounded mass of red meat with broad footprint and scattered warm flecks. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

sources.label: NetHack Wiki: Huge chunk of meat

object:meat ring.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a dark red closed ring of meat with a clear central opening and brighter upper rim. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:meat ring.wikiDescription: A meat ring is a fleshy comestible. The edible ring identity supports the hole, while the exact red treatment comes from the tile.
object:meat ring.modelBrief: Build a thick torus of red meat with a visible open center and subtle warm highlights. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:glob of gray ooze.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a low gray-brown amorphous blob with a pale square highlight and dark base. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:glob of gray ooze.wikiDescription: Globs are edible remnants dropped by oozes and puddings; the gray-ooze glob is one of four types.
object:glob of gray ooze.modelBrief: Build a low soft gray ooze glob with an uneven rim and pale upper highlight, without a face. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:glob of brown pudding.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a low warm-brown amorphous glob with a pale gold highlight and dark foot. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:glob of brown pudding.wikiDescription: The brown-pudding glob is one of four edible globs dropped instead of a corpse.
object:glob of brown pudding.modelBrief: Build a squat brown pudding glob with rounded asymmetry and warm yellow glint. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.

object:glob of green slime.visualDescription: PixelHack shows a vivid green mound with angular lime facets and a very dark base. The patterned teal floor is background.
object:glob of green slime.wikiDescription: The green-slime glob is an edible remnant of green slime, though eating it is dangerous.
object:glob of green slime.modelBrief: Build a small lumpy green slime mass with a bright lime face and no eyes or limbs. Keep the silhouette and sparse highlights clear at 32-pixel size.
